source.place: Proof: componentwise cartesian section identification (left inverse equation)

proof.text: For each K use component monicity and a component section. Cancel the exchange component in the section equation to get the opposite inverse equation, so the component is an isomorphism. Apply NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app to obtain the natural-transformation inverse, whose inv_hom_id equation proves the claim. The component lemmas receive the unchanged unit-square-counit expression by reflexivity.
